shots.p: wide shot of an ancient leather-bound book closed on a wooden stand in a quiet stone room, soft morning light falling across it, dust motes glowing, calm and firm atmosphere
medium shot of a crowd of Arab townspeople in a dusty old market square looking at each other in disbelief and murmuring, warm afternoon light
close-up on the hopeful faces of a few believers smiling with quiet confidence, golden light behind them
aerial view of vast mountains, oceans and clouds under a sky filled with stars and a rising sun, showing an ordered universe, epic wide establishing shot
time-lapse style wide shot of a dry seed splitting open in dark soil and a green sprout rising toward the light, symbol of life returning, soft dawn glow
wide shot of the bright sun at noon over a desert, then split horizon with a crescent moon in phases across a deep blue night sky, calendar of days and months
split-frame wide shot of day turning into night over a valley, the sky shifting from golden sunset to a starry dome, mountains and trees still and majestic
medium shot of a careless wealthy man lounging among gold and silk cushions, ignoring a sunset sky full of beauty outside his window, distracted by his coins
wide shot of a man standing alone at the edge of a barren cracked desert as a distant firestorm glows red on the horizon at dusk, his shoulders slumped in regret
wide shot of a family of believers walking along a green path toward a lush garden valley with clear streams flowing beneath trees, soft morning light
medium shot of joyful worshippers in a garden on earth at sunrise, hands raised in gratitude, greeting each other warmly with smiles, flowers and running water around them
close-up of an angry man shouting into a stormy sky, clouds swirling above him, while lightning holds back in the distance, tense atmosphere
medium shot of a sick man lying on his side in a dim room raising his hands in desperate supplication

medium shot of people bowing before a lifeless stone idol in a dim temple, the idol cracked and unable to move, dust in the air
wide shot of one crowd standing together on a plain, then splitting into two groups walking in different directions under a dividing sky

wide shot of a wooden sailing ship gliding on calm sea with a fair wind, passengers smiling

wide shot of a lush green field after rain full of golden crops and flowers

close-up on the radiant peaceful faces of a group of believers in a sunlit garden on earth, no trace of worry, glowing with joy
